name: Medikit Co.,Ltd.
summary: Medikit Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells medical devices related to blood vessels and blood in Japan and internationally. The company offers IV catheters, such as Supercath 5 and Supercath Ztu-V; hemodialysis products, including Supercath PRO, Supercath NEO, and Supercath Clampcath; and intervention products comprising Supersheath sheath introducers and Mongoose angiography catheters. It also provides indwelling needles for artificial dialysis; and needles for blood transfusions and intravenous fluid. Medikit Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.
